v07-door-11.observed_description: An old man with a long white beard and a flat cap waters flowers by his blue front door; a small plaque by the door reads 11.
v07-door-11.note: Usable: the 11 reads at 360 px and nothing else shows a digit. The plaque sits at the left edge, so the photo stays out of four-picture cards (four_card false).
